action: Initiated application implementation for request: "Build a modern AI-powered Personal Study Assistant that helps students study smarter. It should allow users to upload PDFs, DOCX, PPTs, images, and handwritten notes, chat with uploaded study materials, summarize chapters, explain concepts at different difficulty levels, generate quizzes and flashcards, create personalized study plans, track progress, solve doubts with AI, generate mock tests, analyze diagrams, provide interview preparation, support voice input and text-to-speech, maintain study history, and offer a beautiful responsive dashboard with dark/light mode. Use React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT authentication, vector search for document retrieval, AI provider abstraction (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Anthropic), Docker, REST API, testing, documentation, and a production-ready architecture."

Expanded prompt. Inferred features: Multi-Format Document Ingestion & Parsing, Vector Search RAG Chat & Doubt Solver, Adaptive Flashcards & Quiz Generator, Personalized Study Plan & Progress Dashboard, Voice Input & Text-to-Speech (TTS), Authentication & Session Management
Completed requirements mapping. Framework: saas, Database: postgresql
Applied 2 startup fix(es): Added missing core React/Vite dependencies; Installed dependencies via npm install
